title: Embossed region from a circle
description: A circle with a 14.5 x 14.0 mm outline (16.5 x 16 mm with its 2 mm line) in the middle of the 40 mm square converted to an embossed region (shape.emboss / Convert from Outline). PE-DESIGN 11.50 drops every needle point inside and leaves the fill's rows whole across it, up to 14.3 mm (within 6 mm of the centre 13 needle points per cm2, the under sewing's, against 126 without it); OpenStitch keeps whole stitches up to 14.5 mm from where a row enters and sews the rest last (12 per cm2 there).

evidence.note: PE-DESIGN 11.50 round-10 capture 471-embossed-region-circle.pes (SHA-256 9c291dff6fa3607bb7e736636033b0ce61b7095ec9dfbd5bb56f326f26d02fc5, 3191 stitches), measured for #471; the reference file since #959

references.make: On a 180 x 130 mm Design Page draw a square with Home > Shapes > Rectangle, 42.00 x 42.00 mm with its line (a 40 mm outline from 30 to 70 mm), PE-DESIGN's defaults kept: line Zigzag Stitch 2.0 mm, 4.5 line/mm, Half Stitch on; region Fill Stitch 4.5 line/mm, 45 degrees, under sewing on. Draw a circle in its middle with Home > Shapes > circle, 16.50 x 16.00 mm with its 2 mm zigzag line (a 14.5 x 14.0 mm outline), defaults kept. Select both (Ctrl+A) and choose Home > Stamp/Emboss > Convert from Outline > Embossed Region: the circle becomes a stamp in the square's fill. Save As 'Layout & Editing Ver 11.0 File (*.PES)'. Status bar 3191 st.

measurements.evidence: 3,123 stitches: 53 fewer than the plain square (PE-DESIGN 60 fewer), on the 40 mm square with the 14.5 mm circle
the rows cross the raised circle whole: up to 14.2 mm (PE-DESIGN 14.3 mm)
